summary.headline: Lord of the Eleventh House
summary.text: Chapter XVIII interprets the lord of the eleventh house in the twelve places, describing effects on friends, siblings, parents, children, marriage, enemies, the principate, and social conduct. The preceding passage continues interpretations for the lord of the tenth or another planetary ruler across houses.
